caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical blue box with a matching blue lid. The lid is positioned loosely on top of the box, partially tilted and leaning, exposing the interior. Both the box and the lid are rendered in a worn and aged manner, with visible scuff marks and faded areas revealing a lighter or brownish color beneath the blue paint. The box sits centered against a plain, off-white background, and no other objects are present in the composition. The shading and details suggest a textured surface on both the box and the lid, highlighting their distressed condition. There is some handwritten text in the lower and upper right corners, but it does not interact with the box itself.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
